title: Tianji Unity
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Record spoke to Chen Ji for the first time in its complete form: "I can help you, but you must promise me one thing."

text.content: That voice pierced through the formation like a软刀 dipped in cold poison, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's heart. He spun around abruptly, only to see a hunched figure slowly entering from the hall entrance—withered like rotten wood, yet radiating a pressure that made heaven and earth lose color. A familiar from twenty years ago who should have died in the Forbidden Grounds—his Shishu, Chen Xuan's fellow sect brother, Zhou Shenyan. "Xiao Jizi, seeing your Shishu, why aren't you happy?" Zhou Shenyan grinned, revealing a mouth of broken yellow teeth. "These twenty years, Shishu has missed you terribly." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his hand hidden in his sleeve quietly gripping the Tianji Record Fragment. Under the extreme pressure, the burning sensation in his chest grew increasingly intense—that was the fragment vibrating wildly.

dialogue.content: "Shishu Zhou Shenyan... Weren't you supposed to be..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, every word seeming to be squeezed out from between his teeth. His mind was racing frantically—if this person had witnessed Chen Xuan's fall twenty years ago and was still alive, then the truth of that day in the Forbidden Grounds could never be as simple as what he knew.

text.content: Zhou Shenyan advanced slowly, each step stepping on Chen Ji's heartstrings. "Dead? Hehe..." He laughed like a kind elder, but there was no warmth in his eyes. "There is another world within the Forbidden Grounds—did your dead Ghost Master never tell you? He snatched something that belonged to me, deserving his fate!" Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, as if the Tianji Record Fragment sensed its sworn enemy and was burning furiously. At that moment, all the fragments in his body trembled simultaneously—metal, wood, water, fire, earth, the Five Elements fragments racing wildly through his meridians, trying to break free and unite as one.

dialogue.content: At this moment, an existence beyond human voice resounded directly in Chen Ji's mind: "Host has reached triggering conditions. Initiate Fragment Resonance Protocol?" Chen Ji shuddered—this was the first time the Tianji Record Fragment communicated with him proactively. At the same time, he sensed more—beyond the Five Elements fragments, four more fragments of wind, thunder, light, and darkness were converging toward his location from all directions. Zhou Shenyan's expression finally changed: "The Tianji Record is calling its fragments? Impossible, unless..."

text.content: A wild idea flashed through Chen Ji's mind. Extreme pressure, fragment resonance, and Zhou Shenyan as an invincible strong enemy—if he could forcibly trigger the unification of all fragments at this moment, perhaps... he could gain enough power to turn the tables! At this moment, a familiar voice sounded in his ear—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. "Don't!" Mo Xiansheng's voice was urgent and terrified. "Host must not act rashly! The price of the complete Tianji Record far exceeds what you can bear!"

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record Fragment vibrated wildly in his body, and complete unification seemed only one step away. Mo Xiansheng's warning still echoed in his ears, while Zhou Shenyan's killing intent was right at hand. Chen Ji had to make a choice in an instant—

choices.description: Seize the opportunity before Zhou Shenyan strikes. Regardless of the cost, survival first. Extreme pressure is precisely the triggering condition—miss this chance and there's no other village with this inn.
choices.visible_cost: Consume unknown price, possibly involving lifespan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete Tianji Record abilities, can peer into the complete fate thread of the next three days
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng strongly opposes, indicating the price is extremely terrifying

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth and roared: "Unite!" The burning in his chest instantly transformed into tearing agony. The Five Elements fragments exploded within his body,化作 five streams of light rushing toward his limbs and meridians. At the same time, the wind, thunder, light, and darkness fragments broke through from the void, like returning birds crashing into his body. Nine rays of light intertwined and collided within him, each one seeming to tear his soul. Zhou Shenyan's expression changed drastically, he struck suddenly—a jet-black palm imprint heading directly for Chen Ji's fontanel—yet it was repelled by a golden light half a zhang away!

choices.description: Trust Mo Xiansheng's judgment, forcibly suppress resonance. Though temporarily at a disadvantage, at least preserve the latitude for acomposed choice in the future.
choices.visible_cost: May be severely wounded by Zhou Shenyan
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Tianji Record Fragment, can seek a safer moment for unification in the future
choices.risk_hint: Zhou Shenyan watches eagerly, delay may prove fatal

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the surging power within his body. The nine fragments mourned resentfully as he locked them deep into his meridians. Zhou Shenyan's palm imprint fell heavily. Chen Ji grunted, his entire body blown back three zhang, crashing into the jade pillar behind him. But he survived. The Tianji Record Fragment remained—as long as he lived, there would be opportunity. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying a trace of relief: "Wise choice, Host. Tianji Record unification requires favorable timing, geography, and harmony. Acting hastily only leads to the opposite of what's intended."

choices.text: Attempt to Guide Resonance Without Full Release
choices.description: Since the fragments have already responded, might as well go with the flow, but only guide part of the power's release—enough to intimidate Zhou Shenyan without triggering the complete price.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of control failure, mutual destruction
choices.visible_reward: Display partial strength, test Zhou Shenyan's reaction
choices.risk_hint: The risk of power going out of control is extremely high

text.content: Chen Ji turned his thoughts, guiding the nine fragments to hover between thirty and seventy percent with his will. In an instant, a majestic aura burst from within him, yet was forcibly suppressed within controllable limits. Golden light gathered in his palm, forming a miniature phantom of the Tianji Record. Zhou Chenyuan's pupils constricted sharply: "This... the main body projection of the Tianji Record? You've actually collected so many fragments!" A glint of greed flickered in his eyes, accompanied by more than a little wariness. "Good lad, you truly haven't disappointed your shishu!"

Whatever Chen Ji chose, the manifestation of the complete Tianji Record would be the core climax of this chapter. If he chose to initiate the resonance immediately, the nine fragments would forcibly merge, and the complete Tianji Record would descend upon the world amid blood and fire. In an instant, the heavens and earth lost their colors, the sun and moon lost their light. Chen Ji felt his consciousness drawn into a chaos as the nine fragments transformed into nine pillars of light, piercing through his soul. When the radiance faded, he found himself standing upon an endless star sea, and before him, a complete Tianji Record slowly unfurled.

dialogue.content: "Twenty thousand years." An ancient yet majestic voice echoed through the star sea—the voice of the Tianji Record's main body. "You are the closest to completeness among all hosts throughout history." Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the shock in his heart and asked in a low voice: "What are the abilities of the complete version? And what is the price?" The Tianji Record fell silent for a moment, then replied: "You may gaze upon the complete fate lines within three days—not three hours, but three days entire. All whose destinies intertwine, their past and future lie within a single thought of yours." Chen Ji's heart raced wildly. Three days of foresight—this was simply worlds apart!

text.content: "And the price?" Chen Ji pressed on, his voice somewhat hoarse. The Tianji Record's voice remained calm, yet struck his soul like thunder: "Each use consumes ten years of your lifespan." Chen Ji's face turned pale. Ten years of lifespan—he was merely twenty years old now, and even if he cultivated to immortality, how many times could he endure? However, the Tianji Record's voice had not yet finished: "Moreover, after three uses, a deadly backlash will inevitably trigger—at that time, Heaven's Dao will personally act to erase everything." Chen Ji猛地抬头，仿佛看到了一个巨大的阴影正在注视着他，那是……天道之眼！" Chen Ji raised his head sharply, as if seeing a massive shadow gazing down at him—that was... the Eye of Heavenly Dao!

choice.prompt: The abilities and costs of the complete Tianji Record had been revealed. The price of ten years of lifespan per use, and the deadly backlash after three uses, made this choice unbearably heavy. Chen Ji had to make his decision under the Tianji Record's gaze—

choices.text: "Accept the complete version, use it immediately"
choices.description: "Zhou Chenyuan's threat is imminent. If I don't accept now, I may not even have a chance to survive. Use it once first, secure my life first."
choices.visible_reward: "Foresight of complete fate lines within three days is enough to reverse the current crisis"
choices.risk_hint: "After one use, two more uses will lead to certain death—three chances means certain death when exhausted"

text.content: ""I accept!" Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment. In an instant, a profound power surged from the Tianji Record and poured into his soul. The scene before his eyes shifted abruptly—he saw Zhou Chenyuan's every attack trajectory within three days, saw how he found a thread of survival in certain death, and also saw... an unexpected figure approaching from afar. Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, a cold smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Shishu Zhou Chenyuan, do you know what I've seen?"

choices.text: "Accept, but do not use for now"
choices.description: "Activate the complete version's power first, but save the usage opportunities for the most critical moment. The activation cost of three years of lifespan is acceptable—what matters is preserving all three foresight opportunities."
choices.visible_reward: "Activate the complete version, preserve all three usage opportunities"
choices.risk_hint: "After activation, each use still costs ten years of lifespan"

text.content: ""I accept the complete version, but I won't use it today." Chen Ji said in a deep voice. The Tianji Record seemed to pause slightly, then replied: "A wise choice, Host. The complete version has merged with your soul; the three opportunities should be used at moments that can truly change fate." Chen Ji felt a power settling deep within his soul—unused, yet he could already vaguely sense its presence. He turned to look at Zhou Chenyuan, his eyes now much more composed: "Shishu, you waited twenty years, wasn't it for the Tianji Record? Unfortunately, it has already recognized its master."

choices.description: "Since the Tianji Record is a divine artifact, there may be room for negotiation. Chen Ji attempts to bargain with the Tianji Record's main body, seeking possibilities that don't consume lifespan."
choices.visible_cost: "May anger the Tianji Record, lose the chance to activate the complete version"
choices.visible_reward: "If successful, may obtain an alternative solution that doesn't consume lifespan"
choices.risk_hint: "The Tianji Record's patience is limited; bargaining may backfire"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly asked: "Besides lifespan, is there any other price?" The Tianji Record fell silent for a very long time, so long that Chen Ji thought it would never respond. "There is." Finally, that ancient voice sounded again. "Substituting with the lifespan of those entangled by fate also works." Chen Ji's eyes lit up: "What does that mean?" The Tianji Record replied: "If there are those around you willing to share your burden, their lifespan can be converted into your price. For those who share destiny, the proportion of sharing can reach as high as seventy percent." Chen Ji's heart stirred, thinking of a certain person...

Whatever Chen Ji chose, the first manifestation of the complete Tianji Record would shock everyone present. Zhou Chenyuan's expression became extremely ugly; he felt that transcendent power beyond the mortal realm, that was the aura of Heavenly Dao's laws. "You... you actually really did it..." Zhou Chenyuan's voice trembled for the first time. "The complete Tianji Record, no one has assembled it in twenty thousand years! By what right!" Chen Ji slowly straightened his body, though his face was pale, his eyes burned with unprecedented light. The complete Tianji Record's power flowed within him, making him feel as if he could see through all disguises in this world.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-piercing chill rise from the depths of his divine soul. The Eye of Heavenly Dao had been watching him all along? All his plans, all his schemes over the years, had been carried out under the gaze of this terrifying existence? This was too ridiculous. He thought he had accounted for every possibility, yet he was merely being manipulated by a higher-level existence. However, the Tianji Record's voice rang out again, bringing a glimmer of opportunity: 'But this Record has merged with your divine soul. From this moment, your fate will be written by yourself—or...' The Tianji Record paused. 'Together with the one willing to share your destiny.'

choice.prompt: The truth of the Eye of Heavenly Dao left Chen Ji shivering, while the 'co-destined' person mentioned by the Tianji Record was the true turning point. At this crossroads of fate, Chen Ji had to decide his next move—

choices.text: Immediately use Foresight to see the method to break the situation
choices.description: Since the complete version has been activated, why not use it once first? Let's see how Zhou Shenyan will make his move within three days, and how I should respond. The cost of ten years is worth it.
choices.visible_cost: Ten years of lifespan (if not yet used)
choices.visible_reward: Foresight the complete fate line of the next three days, obtain the key to breaking the situation
choices.risk_hint: The three chances will be reduced to two

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. With a thought, the power of the complete Tianji Record exploded forth. In an instant, countless visions surged into his divine soul like a tide—he saw every move Zhou Shenyan would make within three days, he saw Su Qingyao rushing toward him from a thousand miles away, he saw how he would trigger a hidden formation in a desperate situation... And, he saw a blurry figure—that was Chen Nian! His younger sister, seemingly somewhere nearby!

choices.text: Ask the Tianji Record for information about the co-destined person
choices.description: The 'co-destined' person mentioned by the Tianji Record intrigued Chen Ji greatly. If someone truly willing to share the cost existed, it would be a tremendous turning point.
choices.visible_cost: Wasting time, Zhou Shenyan might take the opportunity to strike
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the co-destined person, possibly unlocking new cooperation possibilities
choices.risk_hint: Asking might provoke the Tianji Record or attract the Eye of Heavenly Dao's attention

text.content: 'Who is the co-destined person?' Chen Ji asked directly. 'Is there someone among my companions who fits the criteria?' The Tianji Record fell silent for a moment, then answered: 'Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao. Her trust in you has reached a critical point. Once it crosses that threshold, the co-destined pact can be triggered. At that time, she can bear seven-tenths of the cost for you.' Chen Ji's heart shook. Su Qingyao? Wasn't she always investigating him? The Tianji Record seemed to sense his doubt: 'Trust, sometimes, is stronger than Bloodline. She has come infinitely close to the truth, yet chose to protect rather than expose—this is the foundation of co-destiny.'

choices.text: Deal with Zhou Shenyan first, everything else later
choices.description: No matter what the Tianji Record says, Zhou Shenyan is the immediate threat. Use existing means to deal with this old fool first, everything else can wait.
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate Zhou Shenyan, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Zhou Shenyan's strength is unfathomable, direct confrontation carries enormous risk

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, composed himself, and stared directly at Zhou Shenyan: 'Shishu, you've waited twenty years, all for the Tianji Record? Unfortunately, even if you murdered my master back then, this thing won't acknowledge you.' Zhou Shenyan's face turned livid: 'What did you say?' Chen Ji spoke word by word: 'I said, I know everything you did in the Forbidden Grounds back then.' Zhou Shenyan's killing intent pressed down like substance, yet when it touched the golden light surrounding Chen Ji, it was gently deflected. His face changed dramatically: 'Tianji Record protection? How could a Foundation Building junior like you achieve this!'

Just as Chen Ji confronted Zhou Shenyan, a clear, cold voice suddenly came from outside the hall: 'Chen Ji!' It was Su Qingyao's voice, carrying a rare hint of urgency. Chen Ji's heart stirred—the visions from his Foresight had proven true. At the same moment, another voice arose from the shadows behind the hall, a presence Chen Ji had never encountered before—the Tianji Record's true form speaking to him in its complete state for the first time. 'Host,' the aged yet majestic voice rang in his mind, 'Now that the complete version is activated, this Record has a request—and also a condition you must accept.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suppressed the turmoil in his heart and asked in a deep voice: 'What matter?' The Tianji Record's voice turned exceptionally grave: 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao has already noticed you. According to its nature of operation, after you use the complete version three times, it will certainly move to erase you—at that time, everything around you will become its target.' Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: 'So your condition is?' The Tianji Record answered: 'Before you use up your three chances, you must find the one whose fate is most intertwined with yours—your sister, Chen Nian. Only she can disrupt the Eye of Heavenly Dao's Foresight, buying you the opportunity to change your fate.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Nian...

text.content: 'My sister is in the hands of the Holy Sect. How do you expect me to find her?' Chen Ji's voice carried a chill. The Tianji Record answered: 'She is not in the Holy Sect. In the upheaval in the Forbidden Grounds twenty years ago, someone secretly transferred her—that person was Zhou Shenyan.' Chen Ji turned sharply, staring fixedly at Zhou Shenyan, his killing intent almost solidifying into substance. Zhou Shenyan seemed to sense something, his face changed drastically: 'You... What have you learned from it?' Chen Ji spoke word by word, his voice cold as eternal ice: 'Zhou Shenyan, where is my sister?'

dialogue.content: Zhou Shenyan's expression became extremely complex—terror, rage, and a trace of indescribable... sorrow? He threw his head back and laughed, the sound shrill and miserable: 'Tianji Record, Tianji Record, for two hundred thousand years, you've finally chosen him! Back then I went mad for you, sacrificed everything for you, yet you wouldn't even glance at me! Now you've chosen this waste as your host, and you want him to complete your unfinished work! Hahahaha... Ridiculous, utterly ridiculous!' Chen Ji's brow furrowed—the man's madness made him difficult to read. Just then, Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the hall entrance, her gaze sweeping over Zhou Shenyan, her pupils contracting sharply: 'Zhou Shizufu? How are you still alive!'

text.content: Zhou Shenyan's laughter stopped abruptly. He looked at Su Qingyao, his eyes flickering with complex light: 'Girl, you've come at just the right moment. Today, you shall all become witnesses.' He turned to Chen Ji, his voice suddenly becoming calm. 'You want your sister? Fine, I'll tell you where she is—right here, in the deepest part of the Forbidden Grounds, where your dead master fell.' Chen Ji's heart shook. The depths of the Forbidden Grounds? Where his master perished? The Tianji Record's voice rang again in his mind: 'Host, this person speaks truth. But that Forbidden Grounds is sealed with ancient formations; forcing entry will come at a heavy cost.' Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision.

"Su Qingyao." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "What I'm about to say may be hard to believe. But I need your trust—even if just for a moment." Su Qingyao froze. This was the first time Chen Ji had spoken to her in such a tone. That ever-smiling, seemingly harmless junior brother who appeared to have no threat at all—now he was like a volcano about to erupt. She suddenly understood, softly saying: "Speak." Chen Ji turned, his back to Zhou Chenyuan, staring directly into Su Qingyao's eyes: "I'm not atrash. The Tianji Record is real, and so is the truth in the Forbidden Grounds. And my sister... is right in there."

Su Qingyao looked into Chen Ji's eyes, where she saw too many things she had never witnessed—cold detachment, calculation, and a profound weariness. This man, whom she had investigated countless times yet always remained an enigma, now resembled an opened book. She suddenly reached out and gently grasped Chen Ji's wrist. "I believe you." Only two words, yet heavier than a thousand pounds. Chen Ji trembled all over, as that trust flowed from Su Qingyao's wrist, somehow creating a strange resonance between his soul and the Tianji Record. The Tianji Record's voice rang out once more, carrying a hint of satisfaction: "Gongming Agreement has been automatically triggered."

The moment the Gongming Agreement triggered, Chen Ji sensed a warm current rushing from Su Qingyao, intertwining with the power of the Tianji Record within him. Between him and Su Qingyao, it was as if some connection beyond language had formed—he could perceive her heartbeat, and she could sense his emotions. This was Gongming, a result outside Chen Ji's plans yet destined by the heavens. Zhou Chenyuan's face turned ashen with fury; he felt that power, the resonance of those bound by fate: "Good, good, good! Atrash, a foolish woman, and that damned remnant soul... Today, I shall reunite you all!"

Zhou Chenyuan struck ruthlessly, his jet-black palm print blotting out the sky, carrying twenty years of hatred and madness, targeting Chen Ji and Su Qingyao's lives. However, just then, the complete Tianji Record automatically activated, a golden light screen enveloping the two. The palm print collided with the screen, producing a thunderous roar, yet it couldn't move an inch. Zhou Chenyuan's pupils contracted sharply, his face full of disbelief: "Impossible! The Tianji Record's protective force—even a Yuanying Stage cultivator couldn't withstand it. How could a Foundation Buildingtrash possibly wield it?" A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, that smile carrying a suppressed edge: "Because I never fight a battle I'm not certain to win."

Before his words even finished, the complete Tianji Record within Chen Ji suddenly vibrated, and an ancient, majestic voice rang from the void. It was the first time the Tianji Record's true form had spoken to Chen Ji in its complete state. "Host," that voice as desolate as primordial chaos, "the unification of the Tianji Record—first time in two hundred thousand years. This Record can help you, but you must agree to one condition." Chen Ji's heart tightened—this was the Tianji Record's true condition. He said solemnly: "Speak." The Tianji Record's voice turned incomparably grave: "Find your sister Chen Nian, and have her complete the final resonance of fate with you. Only thus can you completely escape the gaze of the Tiandao Zhi Yan—otherwise, no matter how many times you use the Tianji Record, in the end you will merely be a piece on that pair of eyes' chessboard."

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then asked the greatest doubt in his heart: "My sister was captured by the Holy Sect so many years ago. Why didn't you tell me sooner?" The Tianji Record replied: "The existence of the Heavenly Fate Key requires specific conditions to trigger—only when you gather nine fragments and activate the complete version will her aura reappear within this Record's perception. At any previous time point, her fate was tightly shrouded by the Tiandao Zhi Yan; even this Record could not glimpse it." A blurry image of Chen Nian flashed through Chen Ji's heart—that was his only blood relative in this world. The Tianji Record continued: "Now, are you willing to agree to this Record?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, feeling the vast power of the complete Tianji Record within his body, and feeling the trust and warmth emanating from Su Qingyao beside him. At this moment, he suddenly felt that all his years of pretense, forbearance, and scheming had meaning. He opened his eyes, his gaze firm: "I agree to you." The words fell, and the Tianji Record let out a long sigh, as if it had waited for this moment for eons. "Very well." That ancient voice finally rang out, "Then from this moment, the chess game of fate shall completely change. Host, go—find your sister, rewrite this fate that has been manipulated by heaven for two hundred thousand years."

text.content: The golden light dispersed, and Chen Ji found himself still standing in the main hall, Zhou Chenyuan's palm print had long vanished, and Su Qingyao's hand still gripped his wrist. Everything seemed as if nothing had happened, but he knew everything had changed. The power of the complete Tianji Record had settled deep within his soul, ready to be summoned at any moment. The Gongming Agreement had also been activated, establishing between him and Su Qingyao a connection that transcended language. And most importantly—he knew where Chen Nian was. Deep within the Forbidden Grounds, where his Master fell. Zhou Chenyuan gazed at Chen Ji, a trace of terror flickering in his eyes: "You... what did you obtain from it?" Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile sending a chill down Zhou Chenyuan's spine: "Not much, just that I now know everything you did twenty years ago—including where my sister is."
